# Mike Charlie Research

> Genealogy research in European archives, especially Poland, Ukraine, Moldova (historic Bessarabia) and France, for clients mainly in the United States, Germany, Israel and Canada. Also: lineage documentation for proof of Canadian citizenship by descent, archival research for academics (including documents of the Polish Government-in-Exile), historical source verification and open-source intelligence (OSINT). Email-only service. Reports in English or Polish.

Contact: mike.charlie21@proton.me (replies within 24–48 hours; no phone or video calls)

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://osintinvestigator.github.io/osint/): services, research process, principles, FAQ
- [Strona główna (Polski)](https://osintinvestigator.github.io/osint/pl/): Polish version
- [Case study: historical source verification (PDF)](https://osintinvestigator.github.io/osint/assets/case-study-historical-source-verification.pdf)

## Services

- Ancestor search in Poland, Ukraine, Moldova and historic Bessarabia, France and neighbouring countries (parish, synagogue, civil and state records)
- Lineage documentation for proof of Canadian citizenship by descent (research only; no legal advice or application filing)
- Emigration tracing and village-of-origin search (passenger lists, naturalisation, church records abroad)
- Transcription and translation of handwritten records
- 20th-century fates: war, deportation, border changes
- Locating living adult relatives through lawful open sources
- Review of an existing family tree
- Archival analysis for university researchers, including documents of the Polish Government-in-Exile
- OSINT background checks on companies and adults, due diligence, digital footprint, support for journalists and lawyers

## Limits

Does not accept work concerning minors, sexual matters, intrusion into the privacy of uninvolved people, pure speculation, or anything requiring breaking the law or accessing IT systems.
